root_cause.text: In xhci_disable_slot(), error paths freed the command structure with kfree() instead of xhci_free_command(), which leaks the completion structure allocated by xhci_alloc_command() when the second argument is true.
root_cause.evidence: The patch replaces two kfree(command) calls with xhci_free_command(xhci, command) in xhci_disable_slot(). The CVE description states: "xhci_alloc_command() allocates a command structure and, when the second argument is true, also allocates a completion structure. Currently, the error handling path in xhci_disable_slot() only frees the command structure using kfree(), causing the completion structure to leak."
